overall_critique.description: 1-5 sentence overall critique of the rewrite's fidelity to the original.

issues.description: Mark true only if the issue is noticeable enough to meaningfully lower fidelity.

meaning_preservation.description: Changed message, stance, intent, implications, certainty, scope, or takeaway.

information_coverage.description: Important points omitted, altered, or meaningfully added.

factual_consistency.description: Names, dates, numbers, quotes, links, attributions, key terms, or point of view changed.

structural_similarity.description: Meaningful change in form, organization, ordering, sectioning, or length.

overall_score.description: Overall fidelity score. 5 = preserves the original well, 4 = mostly faithful with minor issues, 3 = borderline faithful, 2 = not faithful enough, 1 = major failure.
